title: Finite move, root-space, and refinement-boundary contract for PAH-001
proposed_by: TECT research programme under operator directive

parent.composition_rule: This contract supplements the immutable parent. Every theorem below is about the composite PAH-001 plus PAH-OMC-001 model and is not retroactive evidence that the parent bytes already contained these definitions.

immutability: PAH-001-v1 is not edited or superseded. This contract is a separately versioned owner completion. Any change to its move channels, multiplicities, root measure, domain, or refinement boundary requires PAH-OMC-001-v2 or a new contract ID.

exact_scope.carrier: One finite connected oriented bounded-degree relational two-cell complex G=(V,E,P) with disjoint nonempty anchors O and C.
exact_scope.group: The finite abelian gauge group Z_K^V and the finite anchor-preserving cell automorphism group Aut(G;O,C).
exact_scope.configuration: The unprobed finite fixed-Q Gibbs configuration. The optional tagged probe belongs only to the separate preregistered transfer estimand and is not evolved by L_rho in this contract.
exact_scope.measure: Counting measure on the integer-coordinate state tuples below, followed by the exact PAH-001 Gibbs weight pi_(rho,Q).
exact_scope.limits: No regulator, volume, refinement, phase, aperture, beta, or observation-time limit is taken in the finite theorem.

integer_state_coordinates.matter_phase: n_v in Z_K at every vertex, including ell_v=0. Distinct n_v labels at zero radius remain distinct counting-measure states; no quotient is silently inserted.
integer_state_coordinates.link: For every geometric one-cell q choose the orientation already carried by G and write u_q in Z_K, U_q=zeta_K^(u_q); the reverse orientation has exponent -u_q.
integer_state_coordinates.functional_evaluation: Map the integer tuple to the PAH-001 variables and evaluate the unchanged displayed F_rho.

phase.label: PH(v,sigma), v in V and sigma in {-1,+1}
phase.map: n_v maps to n_v+sigma modulo K; every other coordinate is fixed

matter_transfer.label: TR(q,v_to_w) for each geometric one-cell q with ordered endpoints v,w
matter_transfer.map: ell_v maps to ell_v-1 and ell_w maps to ell_w+1; phases, apertures, and links are fixed

link.label: LK(q,sigma), one geometric one-cell q in its carried orientation and sigma in {-1,+1}
link.map: u_q maps to u_q+sigma modulo K and the reverse exponent remains -u_q; every other coordinate is fixed
link.mobility: m_r(x)=(s_v s_w)^(nu/2) for the endpoints of q

aperture.label: AP(v,sigma), v in V and sigma in {-1,+1}
aperture.map: j_v maps to j_v+sigma; every other coordinate is fixed

invalid_and_duplicate_conventions.invalid_partial_move: An inadmissible root is absent from D_rho and contributes zero to L_rho. It is not reflected, clipped, or converted to a self-loop.
invalid_and_duplicate_conventions.parallel_edges: Roots carry the geometric one-cell ID. Distinct parallel cells are distinct channels even when they induce the same integer-coordinate transition.
invalid_and_duplicate_conventions.K_equals_2: The sigma=+1 and sigma=-1 phase or link labels are retained as two distinct channels even when their state maps coincide modulo 2. Their multiplicity is therefore two exactly as the displayed increment/decrement list prescribes.
invalid_and_duplicate_conventions.zero_radius_phase: PH roots remain valid at ell_v=0 because the integer phase label is part of the counting-measure state. This is a model convention, not a physical quotient.
invalid_and_duplicate_conventions.channel_counting: Every retained root label appears exactly once in the generator sum and exactly once in the directed-root Hilbert measure.

symmetry_action_on_states_and_roots.gauge_on_states: g in Z_K^V sends n_v to n_v+g_v and u_q to u_q+g_w-g_v in the carried orientation q=(v,w); j and ell are fixed.
symmetry_action_on_states_and_roots.gauge_on_roots: Gauge transformations fix every root label. Each partial root map commutes with the gauge action because Z_K is abelian.
symmetry_action_on_states_and_roots.automorphism_on_states: h in Aut(G;O,C) relabels vertices, geometric one-cells, plaquettes, j, ell, n, and u. If h reverses the carried orientation of q, the target link exponent changes sign.
symmetry_action_on_states_and_roots.automorphism_on_roots: h sends PH(v,sigma) to PH(hv,sigma), TR(q,v_to_w) to TR(hq,hv_to_hw), AP(v,sigma) to AP(hv,sigma), and LK(q,sigma) to LK(hq,orientation_sign(h,q)*sigma).
symmetry_action_on_states_and_roots.admissibility_equivariance: r is admissible at x if and only if h.r is admissible at h.x for every gauge or anchor automorphism h.

generator_and_projection.admissible_incidence_set: D_rho={(x,r): x in Omega_(rho,Q) and r is admissible at x}.
generator_and_projection.group_representation: (U_h f)(x)=f(h^(-1).x) for h in Z_K^V semidirect Aut(G;O,C).
generator_and_projection.candidate_projection: P_cand=P_Aut P_G is unchanged from PAH-001 and equals the finite average onto H_rho^inv={f:U_h f=f for every h}.
generator_and_projection.finite_common_invariant_core: A_rho^inv=H_rho^inv, the complete finite-dimensional invariant function space. It is simultaneously the domain of L_rho restricted to invariant observables, P_cand, B_rho, and B_rho^*B_rho.
generator_and_projection.commutation_target: U_h L_rho=L_rho U_h for every h, hence [P_cand,L_rho]=0 and L_rho A_rho^inv is contained in A_rho^inv.

directed_root_hilbert_space.multiplicity: Counting measure on the exact retained directed labels, including the declared K=2 and parallel-edge multiplicities.
directed_root_hilbert_space.domain_B: dom(B_rho)=C^(Omega_(rho,Q)); all functions are bounded because Omega is finite.
directed_root_hilbert_space.domain_adjoint: dom(B_rho^*)=K_rho; B_rho^* is the unique finite-dimensional Hilbert adjoint under the displayed state and root inner products.
directed_root_hilbert_space.inverse_incidence_involution: I(x,r)=(r.x,r^(-1)) is a fixed-point-allowed measure-preserving involution of D_rho; duplicate channels remain label-distinct under I.
directed_root_hilbert_space.factorization_target: <B_rho f,B_rho g>_root=<f,-L_rho g>_(pi), hence B_rho^*B_rho=-L_rho on C^(Omega) and on A_rho^inv.

finite_theorem_targets: Every displayed root family is an inverse-closed system of partial bijections on the fixed-Q state space.
The move, mobility, rate, and incidence measure are gauge- and anchor-automorphism-equivariant.
P_cand is idempotent and self-adjoint and commutes with L_rho on A_rho^inv.
Detailed balance and the directed-root factor 1/2 give B_rho^*B_rho=-L_rho with no sign, measure, multiplicity, or domain ambiguity.
T_rho(t)=exp(tL_rho) is a reversible finite Markov contraction preserving A_rho^inv.

anchor_preserving_isomorphism_sanity_mor.definition: For an anchor-preserving oriented cell isomorphism h:G->G', transport every regulator parameter identically, push state and root labels by h, and set (iota_h f)(x')=f(h^(-1).x').
anchor_preserving_isomorphism_sanity_mor.intertwining: iota_h L_rho=L_(h.rho) iota_h and the corresponding root incidence maps intertwine exactly.
anchor_preserving_isomorphism_sanity_mor.boundary: This is relabelling naturality only. It is not lattice refinement, does not change a, and supplies no limit.

tested_nontrivial_candidate.setup: A refinement retains a coarse vertex v, adds a freely varying adjacent vertex z, and uses the natural coarse-state projection p that forgets fine-only variables; iota_p f=f composed with p.
tested_nontrivial_candidate.parameter_transport: All unchanged PAH-001 scalar couplings are transported identically; no new cell weights, counterterms, frozen fine fields, or rate rescaling are inserted.
tested_nontrivial_candidate.obstruction: For an admitted aperture increment s_v=s to s+delta with 0<epsilon<1, the added edge contributes D_z(s_z)=kappa_s[(s+delta-s_z)^2-(s-s_z)^2]/2 to the fine energy increment. For two admissible fine values z_1!=z_2, D_z(z_1)-D_z(z_2)=-kappa_s delta(z_1-z_2)!=0. Thus the fine aperture rate, and L_(rho')iota_p f for a cylinder f detecting j_v, varies inside one p-fibre, whereas iota_p L_rho f is fibre-constant.
tested_nontrivial_candidate.scope_boundary: The counterexample rejects the free-vertex restriction/pullback morphism with unchanged positive kappa_s. It is not a no-go for every possible block map, conditional expectation, parameter transport, or separately versioned weighted functional.

missing_owner_choice: A named nontrivial anchor-preserving cell-subdivision functor.
A coarse-state map or observable embedding that handles new fluctuating fields.
Transport laws for Q, local cutoffs, a, beta, nu, theta, and cell coupling weights.
A move/root embedding or lumping kernel compatible with the selected coarse map.
A decision between exact intertwining and an explicitly quantified approximate boundary-defect theorem.
refinement_contract.why_not_supplied: PAH-001 contains no owner choice among these inequivalent constructions. Selecting one would add substantive microscopic structure. The natural source-minimal restriction map already fails exact generator intertwining, so this contract records the failure rather than disguising an isomorphism as refinement or altering F_rho.

ordered_limit_firewall.current_admission: No step in this order is admitted by the finite common-dynamics theorem.

falsifiers: An admissible root lacks the stated inverse or violates fixed Q.
A gauge or anchor automorphism fails move, mobility, or rate equivariance.
A duplicate-channel count differs between L_rho and K_rho.
The displayed root inner product produces any sign or factor other than B_rho^*B_rho=-L_rho.
P_cand fails to commute with L_rho on an exact enumerated finite fixture.
The free-vertex obstruction vanishes under its stated positive-kappa_s, nonzero-delta, distinct-fibre assumptions.
non_claims: This contract does not make PAH-001 an established TECT law or physical source owner.
No nontrivial refinement, uniform limit, continuum theory, physical projection, F_lim, F_eff, or F_obs is admitted.
No Markov time is identified with quantum real time, proper time, or Lorentzian time.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, event-horizon, area-law, Lorentz, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin, or TOE conclusion follows.
The free-vertex counterexample is route-local and not a global no-go for all successor models.
single_next_action: The owner must choose and hash-pin one nontrivial anchor-preserving subdivision/coarse-map/parameter-transport contract, then prove exact intertwining or preregister a quantitative boundary-defect estimate before any uniform-limit calculation.
